items.source: Dispatching Enhancer callback. This is the same as the Dispatcher except for the addition of an argument which references the proxy object.
items.translation: 分发 `Enhancer` 回调。这与 `Dispatcher` 相同，只是增加了一个引用代理对象的参数。

items.source: proxy - a reference to the proxy (generated) object
items.translation: proxy - 对代理（生成）对象的引用

items.source: Return the object which the original method invocation should be dispatched. This method is called for every method invocation.
items.translation: 返回原始方法调用应调度的对象。此方法针对每个方法调用被调用。
